description: Observed prompt variants of Claude Code's built-in /code-review, keyed by CLI version. The hash is SHA-256 of the UTF-8 prompt body the forked subagent received: its first user message with the first line (the 'Review target:' line, which carries the argument and any packet text folded into it) removed and surrounding whitespace stripped, so the same variant hashes identically across targets; body_bytes is the byte length of that body. Selection depends on the session --effort flag and the model; the effort argument alone does not select a variant (observed 2026-09-24). A run manifest records which entry each built-in attempt matched; an unmatched hash is a new variant to register before the attempt counts. file_attempt.py computes the hash.

variants.output_contract: fenced JSON array in the final message (file, line, summary, failure_scenario); ReportFindings forbidden

variants.header: `high effort → 8 inline angles → dedup (no verify) → ≤10 findings`
variants.output_contract: ReportFindings call (file, line, summary, failure_scenario, category, verdict)

variants.header: `minimal prompt → single careful diff pass → ≤15 findings`
variants.selected_by: no session effort flag (harness default), model claude-opus-5-5; also selected with the effort argument alone

notes: Phase 0 of every variant runs `git diff main...HEAD` (or `git diff HEAD~1`) regardless of the range argument; the local base branch must be named main.
The high Sonnet variant did not fan out its angles or run a verifier on a five-line diff; fan-out on grid-sized diffs is recorded per attempt from the subagent count.
The root transcript records no billed request; the review runs in <session-dir>/subagents/agent-*.jsonl.

notes: Observed by the pre-dispatch probes of run 2026-09-24-builtin-baseline (probes/att-001 Sonnet, probes/att-002 Opus) on the toy fixture: both high variants hash exactly as on 2.1.281.
The low variant (no session effort flag) was not re-observed on 2.1.282; the run does not use it.

The Opus probe ran `git diff main...review-head` (the argument's range) where 2.1.281 ran `git diff main...HEAD`; the Sonnet probe ran `git diff main...HEAD`. Both resolve to the pinned range under the suite's branch layout.
